title: pp-profile
summary: Diagnostic that prints the resolved preprocessor define profile for a project, one symbol per line
intro: Read this when you need to know which compiler defines are active for a project, platform and configuration, before trusting a preprocess or index result. It prints the resolved define set, one symbol per line, exactly as the indexer sees it.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint pp-profile [--dproj PATH] [--platform win32|win64] [--config Release|Debug] (diagnostic: print the resolved define profile, one symbol per line)
help: drag-lint pp-profile [--dproj PATH] [--platform win32|win64] [--config Release|Debug]   (diagnostic: print the resolved define profile, one symbol per line)

questions.ask: Which compiler defines are on for this project?
